# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 3 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1/level-2 spontaneous spell-burden baseline to level 3 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from the level-1/level-2
# fixtures, and the same canonical bloodline and bloodline class-skill
# selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]), adding only the level bump this
# bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bonus spells/feats at 3rd+ (the PF1 CRB
# Sorcerer class table's level-3 "Special" column reads "Bloodline power,
# bloodline spell" — a per-bloodline-specific bonus power and a bonus spell
# known, both explicitly out of scope for this bounded slice, unchanged from
# level 1/2), no spellbook, no spells known, no spell slots, no spell DCs, and
# no level-4+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level3
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:3
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
